results.name: AdjoinRoot
results.source_text:
/-- Adjoin a root of a polynomial `f` to a commutative ring `R`. We define the new ring
as the quotient of `R[X]` by the principal ideal generated by `f`. -/
def AdjoinRoot [CommRing R] (f : R[X]) : Type _ :=
  Polynomial R ⧸ (span {f} : Ideal R[X])
results.docstring:
Adjoin a root of a polynomial `f` to a commutative ring `R`. We define the new ring
as the quotient of `R[X]` by the principal ideal generated by `f`.

results.name: AdjoinRoot.mk_eq_mk
results.source_text:
@[simp]
theorem mk_eq_mk {g h : R[X]} : mk f g = mk f h ↔ f ∣ g - h :=
  Ideal.Quotient.eq.trans Ideal.mem_span_singleton

theorem isRoot_root (f : R[X]) : IsRoot (f.map (of f)) (root f) := by
  rw [IsRoot, eval_map, eval₂_root]

theorem equivalence (p : α → Prop) : Equivalence (@HasEquiv.Equiv (Subtype p) _) :=

results.name: Equiv.sigmaSubtypeFiberEquivSubtype
results.source_text:
/-- If for each `x` we have `p x ↔ q (f x)`, then `Σ y : {y // q y}, f ⁻¹' {y}` is equivalent
to `{x // p x}`. -/
def sigmaSubtypeFiberEquivSubtype {α β : Type*} (f : α → β) {p : α → Prop} {q : β → Prop}
    (h : ∀ x, p x ↔ q (f x)) : (Σ y : Subtype q, { x : α // f x = y }) ≃ Subtype p :=
  calc
    (Σ y : Subtype q, { x : α // f x = y }) ≃ Σ y :
        Subtype q, { x : Subtype p // Subtype.mk (f x) ((h x).1 x.2) = y } := by {
          apply sigmaCongrRight
          intro y
          apply Equiv.symm
          refine (subtypeSubtypeEquivSubtypeExists _ _).trans (subtypeEquivRight ?_)
          intro x
          exact ⟨fun ⟨hp, h'⟩ => congr_arg Subtype.val h', fun h' => ⟨(h x).2 (h'.symm ▸ y.2),
            Subtype.ext h'⟩⟩ }
    _ ≃ Subtype p := sigmaFiberEquiv fun x : Subtype p => (⟨f x, (h x).1 x.property⟩ : Subtype q)
results.docstring:
If for each `x` we have `p x ↔ q (f x)`, then `Σ y : {y // q y}, f ⁻¹' {y}` is equivalent
to `{x // p x}`.

results.name: Set.Finite.of_finite_fibers
results.source_text:
/--
If the image of `s` under `f` is finite, and each fiber of `f` has a finite intersection
with `s`, then `s` is itself finite.

It is useful to give `f` explicitly here so this can be used with `apply`.
-/
lemma Finite.of_finite_fibers (f : α → β) {s : Set α} (himage : (f '' s).Finite)
    (hfibers : ∀ x ∈ f '' s, (s ∩ f ⁻¹' {x}).Finite) : s.Finite :=
  (himage.biUnion hfibers).subset fun x ↦ by aesop
results.docstring:
If the image of `s` under `f` is finite, and each fiber of `f` has a finite intersection
with `s`, then `s` is itself finite.

It is useful to give `f` explicitly here so this can be used with `apply`.

results.name: Physlib.PiTensorProduct.instAddCommMonoidElim_physlib
results.source_text:
/-- Given two maps `s1` and `s2` whose targets carry an instance of an additive commutative
  monoid, the target of the sum of these two maps also carry an instance thereof. -/
instance : (i : ι1 ⊕ ι2) → AddCommMonoid ((fun i => Sum.elim s1 s2 i) i) := fun i =>
  match i with
  | Sum.inl i => inst1 i
  | Sum.inr i => inst2 i
results.docstring:
Given two maps `s1` and `s2` whose targets carry an instance of an additive commutative
monoid, the target of the sum of these two maps also carry an instance thereof.
